name: IRIS-AI Browser Extension
description: Use IRIS browser extension to quickly extract questions from online questionnaires. Use Ask IRIS to get answers to your questions.

content_security_policy.extension_pages: default-src 'none'; script-src 'self' 'wasm-unsafe-eval'; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline' https://fonts.googleapis.com; img-src 'self' data:; font-src 'self' https://fonts.gstatic.com; connect-src 'self' https://beta-api.heyiris.ai https://sheets.googleapis.com https://docs.googleapis.com https://accounts.google.com; object-src 'none'; base-uri 'none'; form-action 'none'
